description.content:
This API allows you to list, create, update, and delete API Keys for a Team.


Learn more about [API keys here](https://docs.honeycomb.io/configure/environments/manage-api-keys/).

## Authorization

 This API requires a Management Key passed via the HTTP Authorization header. Join the key ID and secret with a colon, like this: `Authorization: Bearer <key ID>:<secret>`.
List all API Keys for a Team.

query.description:
The string value of the `next` attribute from a previous result page.
The cursor value must be empty or omitted for the first request of a cursor-paginated query.
The number of entries to include per response. Maximum value is 100.

Specifies the type of API key to return. This parameter accepts the following values:
  - `ingest`: Returns only ingest API keys.
  - `configuration`:  Returns only configuration API keys.

The endpoint will default to fetching all API keys regardless of type if this filter is omitted.

description.content:
This creates an API Key, which will return the API Key components in the response. The Key ID will be found at `data.id` and
the Key Secret will be found at `data.attributes.secret`. For security reasons the Key Secret will only be available during creation so make sure to save it.

To use a newly-created Ingest Key it should be passed in the `X-Honeycomb-Team` header with the API Key's ID and secret
concatenated (and with no separator). For example, `X-Honeycomb-Team: hcxik_1234567890123456789012345612345678901234567890123456789012`

Check out our [best practices for API Keys](https://docs.honeycomb.io/get-started/best-practices/api-keys/#ingest-keys).

description.content:
Updates an API Key. The expected attributes depend on the key type:
- **Ingest Keys** (prefix `hcxik_`): Support `name` and `enabled` attributes
- **Configuration Keys** (prefix `hcxlk_`): Support `name`, `enabled`, and `permissions` attributes
